name: Katima Mulilo Bridge
facts: The Katima Mulilo Bridge, completed in 2004, stretches 900 metres across the Zambezi, featuring 19 spans built with Germany's incremental launching technique, a first for the region.
Opened on 13 May 2004, the bridge was inaugurated jointly by Namibian President Sam Nujoma and Zambian President Levy Mwanawasa, symbolizing newfound cooperation after decades of colonial opposition.
Constructed entirely on Zambian soil to qualify for development grants, the bridge now forms part of Zambia's M10 Road, linking the Walvis Bay‑Ndola‑Lubumbashi Development Corridor.
